payload.entry: Core note-pull grammar and single-item planner done and verified. Grammar: CaptureKind::NotePull for lone @route headers (count==0, Tasks kind, no section), EditorMode::NotePull with needs [] and preserved list metadata, GRAMMAR_REVISION 7 with feat(capture!:) + BREAKING CHANGE footer left to the land agent (no commit made, no version/CHANGELOG/memory edits). Planner (src/native/capture/note_pull.rs): staged classification with NP5 precedence, KM31 dependents-snapshot gate (no snapshot for dependency-free pulls), Pending-Next-Ready then line order, §12.2 keys frozen pre-pick, sequential scratch vs picks-only actual placement, Ready->Next + mint + stamp_fresh writes, refused pull_note_missing/nothing_to_pull_in with additive payloads, rows in all_offer_rows/numbering/completion counts with trigger note_pull and group note_pull, TaskBlockRole::NotePull. Tests: 22 planner tests pin NP1-NP12, NP15, NP21-23 (incl. file-byte assertions for picks/refusals, blocked-project reasons, KM31 unavailable-proof unit, daily-note errors); lists/editor/capture-parse/CLI suites pin NP24-27 and grammar 7. just check and just docs-check both green.

payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: this epic's phases broke the bob-cli build (just install) twice on 2026-11-03. (1) c673d144 (bob-cli-gj.2.1.1) added the required CaptureItemResult.note_pull field but missed the sub-bullet literal that 3b1cf138 (agent 17i) had just added in plan_capture_item, which caused a missing-field compile error. Agent 17l fixed it in 9a606395 by putting note_pull: None first. (2) a95d5d8f (bob-cli-gj.2.1.2) added note_pull: None as the last field of the same literal on a base without 9a606395. The rebase applied cleanly because the hunks are about 80 lines apart, which left E0062 "field note_pull specified more than once". The fix commit drops the trailing copy and keeps the leading one, which matches every other literal. Both phases passed tests on their pre-rebase base, and nothing compiled the rebased tip. Land agent: run cargo check --all-targets --locked on the master tip after each phase lands. bob-cli-gh.8's PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1 is the same first breakage, already fixed by 9a606395.

COORDINATION NOTE: master at a95d5d8f did not compile because note_pull: None appeared twice in plan_capture_item's sub-bullet CaptureItemResult literal (src/native/capture/plan.rs). The fix commit keeps the leading copy, right after "result: CaptureItemResult {", and drops the trailing copy after relation_groups. If your branch already deleted the leading copy to get a build, restore it and delete the trailing one instead. Otherwise the rebase removes both copies and master breaks a third time. payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE (third build break): 3d1822be (bob-cli-gj.2.1.3) broke just install again with E0063 "missing field note_pull" in plan_capture_item's sub-bullet CaptureItemResult literal (src/native/capture/plan.rs). The phase deleted the leading note_pull: None to fix the E0062 duplicate on its stale base, while e74f4f08 had just deleted the trailing copy on master. The two deletions are about 80 lines apart, so the landing rebase applied both cleanly and left none. The fix commit restores the leading copy, which makes plan.rs byte-identical to e74f4f08's version. All three of today's breaks share one mechanism: an agent edited this literal on a stale base, verified it only there, and the rebased tip was never compiled. Break 1 (c673d144, E0063) was a new required field vs. a concurrently added literal. Breaks 2 (a95d5d8f, E0062) and 3 (3d1822be, E0063) were each a concurrent fix of the previous break colliding with another fix, both adding and then both deleting. The COORDINATION NOTE on bob-cli-gj.2.1.3 arrived at 15:17:34, after the phase read its bead at 14:58:50, so bead notes do not reach a running phase. bob-cli-gj.2.1.4 runs on base 3d1822be (no note_pull) and will hit this E0063. If it re-adds the line anywhere but the leading position, the rebase leaves a duplicate (E0062, a fourth break). Land agent: before closing this epic, confirm cargo check --all-targets --locked passes on the master tip and that this literal has exactly one note_pull, in the leading position.

COORDINATION NOTE #2: master from 3d1822be on does not compile (E0063, missing note_pull in plan_capture_item's sub-bullet CaptureItemResult literal in src/native/capture/plan.rs), so your base fails too. The fix commit restores note_pull: None as the literal's first field, on its own line directly after "result: CaptureItemResult {" with the same indentation as "ok: true,". Do not add note_pull anywhere else in that literal. If you already re-added it locally, it must be that exact line in that exact place: git merges an identical addition into one copy, but any other placement rebases cleanly into a duplicate (E0062, a fourth break). Safest: drop your local edit to that literal and build on the current master. Run cargo check --all-targets --locked on your rebased tip before you land.

POST-CLOSE NOTE: this phase's landed commit 3d1822be broke the build (just install) with E0063. Its deletion of the leading note_pull: None in plan_capture_item's sub-bullet literal combined with e74f4f08's deletion of the trailing copy, and the rebase applied both. COORDINATION NOTE #1 above was appended after this phase had read its bead, so it was never seen. The fix commit restores the leading copy. See the DISCOVERED ISSUE notes on bob-cli-gj.2.1.
